en.headline: QEH relocation to Kai Tak Hospital will be seamless, health minister says
en.dek: Kai Tak Hospital begins services in two phases from next month, gradually absorbing clinical services from Queen Elizabeth Hospital while the King’s Park site becomes an ambulatory care centre.
body: Health minister Lo Chung-mau said the relocation of Queen Elizabeth Hospital services to the new Kai Tak Hospital will be carried out in phases to ensure a seamless transition for patients.

Kai Tak Hospital, the largest under the Hospital Authority, will begin services in two phases as planned, with the first phase next month. It will gradually absorb clinical services from Queen Elizabeth Hospital. Officials said the Queen Elizabeth Hospital site in King’s Park will be redeveloped into the city’s first integrated ambulatory care hospital.

Speaking at a press conference on Friday, Lo said patients with follow-up or new appointments at Queen Elizabeth Hospital will be seamlessly relocated to Kai Tak. Even if someone forgets and arrives at the wrong place, service will still be provided on the spot. Of nearly 30,000 nurses in public healthcare, only about 0.6 per cent, or 180, are non-locally trained.

zh.headline: 盧寵茂：威院遷往啟德醫院將無縫過渡
zh.dek: 啟德醫院下月起分兩階段投入服務，逐步接收伊利沙伯醫院臨床服務；京士柏舊址將重建為首間綜合日間醫院。
body: 醫務衞生局局長盧寵茂表示，伊利沙伯醫院服務遷往啟德醫院會分階段進行，確保病人無縫過渡。
啟德醫院是醫管局轄下最大醫院，將按計劃分兩階段投入服務，第一階段下月開始，逐步接收伊利沙伯醫院的臨床服務。當局表示，伊利沙伯醫院京士柏舊址將重建為本港首間綜合日間醫院。
盧寵茂周五在記者會上表示，在伊利沙伯醫院有覆診或新預約的病人將無縫遷往啟德；即使有人忘記而到錯地方，現場仍會提供服務。公營醫療系統近3萬名護士中，只有約0.6%（約180人）是非本地培訓。
